entities.summary: Pete Sandoval (b. 1969-05-21, Santa Ana) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Santa Ana and El Salvador. Known in the fields of el salvador, composers & musicians, americas.
